The Chinese characters for Janet

As a transliteration, Janet is usually written 珍妮特 (Zhēn nī tè). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

珍
Zhēn
treasure, precious
妮
nī
girl, maid
特
tè
special

Origin and meaning

With Hebrew origins, Janet is usually read as “God is gracious (diminutive of Jane)”.

About the name Janet

A diminutive of Jane, common in the mid-20th century.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Janet as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “God is gracious (diminutive of Jane)”, is part of the appeal.
